integration_adaptations: Attention-only BF16 T-by-4096 input/output, with outer HC and norm removed.
Explicit TP=1, S=6, B capacity=64; package-relative imports; no argv/config mutation.
Indexer compressor uses per-request ceil(S/4) boundary slots, initialized unused rows and bounded writeback.
Unused reference harness imports removed; local scalar names do not cross core scopes.
Repository formatting; unused QKV scalar renamed with underscore.
Native compressor norms retain FP32; main/inner compact RoPE use their own group metadata.
Indexer K and FP16 scales share one writable page carrier; page stride and table widths are dynamic.
Read-only indexer arguments reflect their actual role; Top-K outputs exposed for full-chain validation.
Bounded state gather/commit and metadata layout kernels live only in the integration repository.
Native BF16 QA/projection/Hadamard rounding and FP16 QLI scale/weights boundaries; numerical validation ongoing.
RoPE retains Native FP32 coefficients through layout adaptation.
A3 QLI FP16 head coefficients and scaled QK rounding match Native operator boundaries.
Main Q/KV and inverse RoPE preserve Native BF16 materialization boundaries.
WO-B dynamic quantization uses one scale per token across all eight WO-A groups.
QLI weighted reduction uses Cube with separately owned coefficient storage; query merge places new chunks before accumulated results, matching Native tie ordering.
Indexer scratch has a separate runtime scope to fit the default 256 MiB heap rings at B40.
Native QR reduction and quantization operation ordering plus single-accumulator QA/weights projection are under numerical validation.

QA matmul, QR reduction and normalization are extracted as shared integration helpers for production and diagnostic boundaries. Device scalar division and integer midpoint correction of A3 VSQRT preserve Native QR FP32 rounding. Indexer dequant combines activation and weight scales first.

QA follows observed CANN9.0 A3 MatMulV2 K256 block traversal: forward/reverse shifts per 96-column group for M96/144/192/240, N tile32 avoids group crossings; M24/M48 retain unshifted order. Evidence: qa_native_codegen_six.
Indexer Top-K merges 2048-candidate chunks with later chunks first, including merges inside 4096/8192 leaves, matching Native equal-score priority without changing scores.

Indexer compressor projection follows the installed Native arch32 uniform S6 small-T path: N16 tiles, K256 blocks rotated per 16-column group within each 128-column head half. Shared project/pool/write diagnostics match Native exactly at the former continuous step5 failure; evidence: indexer_projection_order_v1 and continuous_b4_korder_v1.

Indexer head weights projection follows observed CANN9.0 A3 MatMulV2 traversal for the six unpadded S6 shapes. Uses N16/K256 with M24 preserving each Native K512 block internally, a single FP32 accumulator, then the existing BF16 publication/scale and FP16 coefficient boundary. Shared functions are used by production and diagnostics. Evidence: weights_korder_v1 and weights_korder_six_v1.

Sparse attention uses Native A3 512-candidate online softmax blocks: original 128-window padded to512 then512 compressed candidates. The sink initializes max/sum, BF16 probabilities use the running max, and FP32 PV is accumulated in K128 Cube chunks. H8 vector groups and explicit GM row offsets keep A3 UB use bounded; no host metadata reads. B4 mixed100 eager/graph PASS and reference18/18 PASS in softmax512_v3 and softmax512_regression_v1.

Indexer compressor RMSNorm matches Native arch32: fold two64-column square vectors before row_sum, vector sqrt, then input/sqrt and gamma. B32 step10 exact normalized/Hadamard/cache boundary after this change; B4 all1/all6/reject_then_accept100 eager+graph PASS. See indexer_rms_order_v1.

Indexer compressor pooling matches Native eight-row overlap layout and ColumnSoftMax: previous/current ratio4 groups interleave, probabilities normalize before multiplying values, and sum/PV use8->4->2->1 reduction. The shared production helper exposes its existing pooled GM buffer to diagnostics. CPU diagnostic and fullCSA compilation PASS; NPU validation queued in indexer_pool_order_v1.
